paragraphs: Rabbi Zeira bar Chanina: Niddah 6, 50b; beginning of Sheviit. Beginning of Jerusalem Talmud, Ein Omedin: Zeira bar Chinena. Beginning of chapter Arba Dinei Mamonot: Zeira bar Chinena in Rabbi Chanina’s and Rav Yehudah’s names. Avodah Zarah 4: in Rabbi Chananya’s name.
